scenes.text: Canva's new *Brush* model edits a *whole design* from one sentence

scenes.title: What *changed*
lines: Oct 29: Canva Brush, its first AI model built to edit designs you already have, not make new ones.
Type the change. It rewrites text, swaps colors, resizes a slide into an Instagram post, across every page at once.

scenes.title: The *money* use
lines: Freelance designers: client revisions are the hours nobody pays for. 'Make the headline shorter, warm up the colors, resize for Stories' is one prompt now.
Charge a flat revision fee. Let Brush do round one.

scenes.title: *Tested*, not hyped
lines: Beta for Canva Pro only; free accounts don't get it yet. Brand Kit support is still coming.
Canva's own numbers: up to 69% faster and 46% cheaper per edit than its old agent. Source: Canva, Oct 29; The AI Economy, Oct 29, 2026.

scenes.title: The *cost*
lines: Canva Pro: $18 a month, or $15 a month billed yearly. Everything Brush touches stays editable, so you can still fix it by hand.
One saved revision hour pays the month.
